name: Demo: SSO handshake fails between Acme Identity Cloud and Zenith Service Desk
description: The canned demo/CI smoke case (blueprint B7/B14): a SAML single sign-on integration between a fictional identity provider and a fictional ITSM tool starts failing after a certificate rotation. Sanitized logs on both sides.

vendor_a.name: Acme Identity Cloud
vendor_a.observation: Signing certificate was rotated on schedule; the admin console shows assertions issued successfully and signed with the new certificate. No errors on the IdP side.

vendor_b.name: Zenith Service Desk
vendor_b.observation: All SSO logins started failing at 09:14 UTC with 'Signature validation failed'. Local (non-SSO) admin login still works. The SP metadata still lists the previous IdP certificate.

user_inputs.logs_a:
2026-08-12T09:14:02Z INFO  acmeid.saml  AssertionIssued entityId=https://sso.acme-identity.example/idp audience=https://desk.zenith.example/sp certSerial=5A:11:0F:2C
2026-08-12T09:14:02Z DEBUG acmeid.saml  SignatureAlgorithm=rsa-sha256 digest=sha256 keyRef=idp-signing-2026
2026-08-12T09:16:41Z WARN  acmeid.saml  MetadataPublish sp=https://desk.zenith.example/sp lastFetchedByPeer=41d ago

2026-08-12T09:14:03Z ERROR zenith.auth.saml  SignatureValidationFailed reason=CERT_MISMATCH assertionId=_9f3d21 issuer=https://sso.acme-identity.example/idp expectedCertSerial=1B:77:A2:90 presentedCertSerial=5A:11:0F:2C
2026-08-12T09:14:03Z INFO  zenith.auth.saml  FallbackLocalLogin enabled=true
2026-08-12T09:20:15Z ERROR zenith.auth.saml  SignatureValidationFailed reason=CERT_MISMATCH assertionId=_a01c77 issuer=https://sso.acme-identity.example/idp expectedCertSerial=1B:77:A2:90 presentedCertSerial=5A:11:0F:2C
user_inputs.use_case: Employees sign in to Zenith Service Desk through Acme Identity Cloud SAML single sign-on; the help-desk team depends on it for every shift handover and ticket escalation.
user_inputs.problem_statement: After Acme Identity Cloud rotated its SAML signing certificate, every SSO login to Zenith Service Desk fails with 'Signature validation failed' even though the IdP reports assertions issued successfully.
user_inputs.impact_statement: Around 300 support agents cannot reach the ticketing system through SSO and are working from a shared local admin account, which violates the customer's access-control policy.
